reason: The sachet is already counted out, so I can throw a few in my bag for work trips and not drag a big bottle around. At $24.99 for the first box and with money back, I would try one box on impulse if a creator's video got me.
objection: Two capsules every single day is a lot to keep up with when I am running around with the kids, and I could easily stop after a week. I also have no proof yet that it helps me sleep.
